pool.title: My Pool
pool.sub: Your trusted circle: every freelancer you completed a pit call with, plus anyone you add through their unique code. Searching inside the pool costs fewer tokens and always shows names in clear.
pool.add_by_code_hint: Ask the freelancer for the unique code shown on their profile.
pool.empty: Your pool is empty. Complete a pit call or add a freelancer by code.
pool.search_hint: Pick one of your pit calls and match it only against your pool.
pool.locked_desc: {{count}} freelancers in your pool. Unlock this pool search for {{cost}} tokens (reduced cost).
pool.unlocked: Pool search unlocked — {{cost}} tokens spent · balance {{balance}}
pool.no_results: No pool freelancer matches this pit call.
pool.my_code_hint: Give this code to a team so they can add you to their pool.
pool.mode_standard_desc: Open to the whole PitCall network. Names stay hidden until the match is confirmed.
pool.mode_pool_desc: Search only inside your trusted circle. Names are shown in clear from the first result.
pool.mode_pool_note: Searching inside your pool ({{count}} freelancers) — names in clear, unlock cost {{cost}} tokens.
